newsitem.title: FINLAND: Forestries, Nokia seen taking Helsinki higher.
newsitem.headline: Forestries, Nokia seen taking Helsinki higher.

text.p: Finnish shares were expected to open higher on Friday with forestries and Nokia seen remaining in the lead, brokers said.
Forestries were seen boosted by a sharp 2.3 percent rise in U.S. paper stocks with particular interest expected in UPM-Kymmene. The strong dollar was also seen lending support to the sector.
Brokers expected Nokia to open up, despite modest overnight losses on Wall Street, cheered by Microsoft's higher earnings released after New York's close.
Nokia's ADR ended at about 298.90 markka, up one markka from its Helsinki close.
Some brokers anticipated higher turnover, assuming that overseas investors would buy forestries and Nokia.
"With forestries this bullish in the U.S. -- I have a feeling that we could see higher volumes today," one said.
Food group Raisio will go ex-dividend today.
